latest_release.name: v5.7.50
latest_release.body:
🌼 Read changelog: https://daisyui.com/docs/changelog/

📦 Install this update:
```bash
npm i -D daisyui@5.7.50
```

💚 Thank you for using daisyUI!

hot_issues.title: bug: performance issue with select + checkbox
bug: Setting `tooltip-end` for tooltip after render lefts extra space on right side only on mobile
bug: <select> overflows on chrome 149, does not respond to css rules
bug: `@apply btn btn-primary` inside `@layer base` is overridden by Tailwind preflight (sublayer `base.daisyui` has lower priority)
bug: `.tooltip` adds to ancestor scrollWidth, producing phantom scrollbars
bug: The component dock pushes up when the keyboard is invoked on mobile
